name: ****gakusei Loli Bitch Tsuma -Shiawase Kazoku Keikaku-
original_name: ○学生ロリビッチ妻―幸せ家族計画―
source:
I, Marina Kuze, was barely born when my parents threw me away.
My name was written on a note when they abandoned me at the orphanage.
But, I never felt sorry for myself. I just yearned to be loved.

The turning point came when a certain man wanted to adopt me.

Really, he said, "I want to marry you."
I was too young to understand it. But I said yes immediately.
He took me home. A warm, loving family at last.
The one thing I had wished for was coming true...

translation:
我，玛丽娜·久世，刚出生就被父母抛弃了。
当他们把我遗弃在孤儿院时，我的名字写在一张纸条上。
但是，我从来没有为自己感到难过。我只是渴望被爱。

转折点出现在某个男人想要收养我的时候。

真的，他说：“我想嫁给你。”
我还太小，无法理解它。但我立即答应了。
他带我回家。终于有了一个温馨有爱的家庭。
我所希望的一件事终于实现了……
